verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an inference engine like vLLM, but the evidence pack never documents memory-locking, mmap, or similar low-level memory or loading overrides. The nearest items are adjacent switches: a per-scheme quantization backend override, `--trust-remote-code`, and `--torch-backend auto`. None of these is the capability the story describes, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can override low-level engine settings like memory locking or mmap behavior instead of being limited to opinionated defaults
